criteria.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs has a docs-only change (changed paths only under docs/ or *.md) with clippy skipped by the skip_when_only rule and test reused from GitHub CI. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` is met, with commands_verified true and no D43 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.
criteria.evidence: The new test `a_docs_only_change_counts_a_docs_skipped_check_and_a_ci_reused_check_as_seen` passed (131 passed in the run). It uses changed paths docs/design/many-agents.md and README.md. Clippy is skipped through the real `skip_note`/`skipped_run` and test is `reused_from_ci(true)`. It asserts that criteria[1].met and commands_verified are true, that `d43_finding` is none, and that the final verdict is Pass. Athena's fails-without-1 run on the reverted copy exited 101 because the test did not compile: the new field is missing there.

criteria.criterion: A new test has a code change (a .rs path changed) with clippy recorded as skipped. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` is still unmet, with commands_verified false and the 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.
criteria.evidence: `a_code_change_does_not_count_a_skipped_check_as_seen` passed. It covers four path lists: verify.rs alone, verify.rs with docs/a.md, docs/a.md with Cargo.toml, and an empty list. For each it calls `assert_unseen` (verify.rs:2194), which asserts that commands_verified and met are false and that a Major D43 finding contains 'cited but not seen running: `cargo clippy --all-targets`'.

criteria.criterion: Existing tests still pass, including a_skipped_check_that_was_not_reused_does_not_count_as_run, a_failed_check_reused_from_ci_does_not_count_as_run and the other-tree tests; a skip for a reason other than the docs-only path rule, or a failed check, still does not count. Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`.
criteria.evidence: Athena's records show that `cargo test --locked` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` passed (reused from CI run 42132678084 for 91101bf). My verify-filtered run passed these existing tests: a_skipped_check_that_was_not_reused_does_not_count_as_run, a_failed_check_reused_from_ci_does_not_count_as_run, a_passing_check_recorded_on_another_tree_does_not_count_as_run, a_check_reused_from_ci_for_another_commit_does_not_count_as_run and a_placeholder_record_without_an_exit_code_does_not_count_as_run. The new test `on_a_docs_only_change_only_a_docs_path_skip_that_passed_on_the_same_tree_counts` passed too. It shows that on a docs-only change a 'CI was not green' note, a missing note, a failed record, another tree and no checks tree all stay unseen.

criteria.criterion: The doc comments on `VerdictInputs`/`judge` in verify.rs state the new rule: a check skipped by the docs-only path rule on a docs-only change counts as seen, and name the docs-only definition used.
criteria.evidence: Read in the diff. Four doc comments carry the rule. `VerdictInputs::commands_run` says a check skipped by the docs-only path rule counts as seen on a docs-only change. The new `VerdictInputs::changed_paths` defines docs-only: a non-empty list where every path matches `docs/` or `*.md` by `checks::path_matches`, and says an empty list is not docs-only. The doc on `judge` states the same rule and definition. So does the comment inside `judge`.

criteria.criterion: The change does not widen what counts as seen for non-docs changes. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and read the diff with `git diff` to confirm the only new counting path is gated on docs-only changed paths.
criteria.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core -q`: 972 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored; the integration tests passed too (2 and 11). The diff changes one thing in the `ran` filter: it adds `|| (docs_change && skipped_for_docs_only(c))`. `docs_change` is false for an empty list and for any path outside docs/ and *.md, so every other input counts exactly as before. The code-change test covers the code-only, mixed and empty lists. (I first ran the suite without -q; the policy hook blocked reading its saved output, so the -q run is the one cited.)

findings.summary: The docs-only patterns are written into verify.rs instead of being read from the check's configured skip_when_only.
findings.evidence: `DOCS_ONLY_PATTERNS = ["docs/", "*.md"]` repeats the `skip_when_only` lists in athena.toml (lines 87 and 92). The copies can drift apart, but drift can only make the rule stricter, never looser. If the config widens, a skip on a non-docs path is not counted. If it narrows, no skip note is written, so the new rule never applies. The request also defines the gate as 'touches only docs', so a fixed docs definition matches it. A later improvement could read the definition from config.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG entry is under 'Added', but it describes a change to how verdicts are judged.
findings.evidence: The entry sits under '### Added'. A 'Changed' section would arguably fit better.

summary: The change does what was asked. Before this change, `judge` never counted a check Athena had skipped as having run. Now, when every changed path is docs-only, it counts a check Athena skipped under the docs-only rule (its `skip_when_only` patterns). A passing check reused from a green CI run already counted before. Docs-only means the path list is not empty and every path matches `docs/` or `*.md`, tested with the same `checks::path_matches` the skip rule uses. The new path is one extra branch in the filter that builds `ran`, guarded by `docs_change && skipped_for_docs_only(c)`. The rule that the candidate tree and the checks tree must match is unchanged. The changed paths come from the same `closing.candidate.changes` list the skip decision uses (`changed_for_skip` in run/mod.rs). Three new tests call `judge` and check `met`, `commands_verified` and the D43 finding. Their skipped record is built by the real `skip_note` and `skipped_run`. In this snapshot I ran `cargo test -p athena-core verify` (131 passed, including the three new tests) and `cargo test -p athena-core -q` (972 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed). I also checked the evidence snapshot: the rejected many-agents job (20261105-103606-svwx) recorded clippy with the note 'not run: every changed path matches skip_when_only (docs/, *.md)', and its only changed file was under docs/. That is exactly the case the new rule accepts. The only finding is minor: the docs-only patterns are written into verify.rs instead of being read from config.
